gloss: brush cutter; grass trimmer; weed cutter

definitions.gloss: brush cutter; grass trimmer; weed cutter
definitions.explanation: A machine for cutting down grass and weeds, typically the shoulder-carried type with a long shaft and a spinning blade or nylon cord at the end. Used on farmland, roadsides, and around houses.

examples.japanese: {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}で{草|くさ}を{刈|か}る。
examples.english: To cut the grass with a brush cutter.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{朝|あさ}から{草刈|くさか}り{機|き}を{動|うご}かしている。
examples.english: My father has been running the brush cutter since morning.

examples.japanese: {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}を{使|つか}うときは、{石|いし}が{飛|と}ぶので{保護|ほご}メガネが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: When you use a brush cutter you need safety goggles, because stones fly up.

notes:
{草刈|くさか}り (grass cutting) + {機|き} (machine). Also written {草刈機|くさかりき} without the okurigana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}をかける: to run a brush cutter over an area
- {草刈|くさか}り{機|き}の{刃|は}: the blade of a brush cutter
- {エンジン式|えんじんしき}{草刈|くさか}り{機|き}: engine-powered brush cutter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}: lawn mower — a wheeled machine for trimming a lawn evenly
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}: brush cutter — a more technical synonym used in catalogs and manuals
